WITH project_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.arcref as project_id,
    p.fundflux as funding_source,
    sp.boxx / CAST(sp.boxz AS REAL) as ratio
  FROM scanspatial sp
  JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE sp.boxx IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz > 0
),
source_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    funding_source,
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM project_ratios
  GROUP BY funding_source
)
SELECT 
  pr.project_id,
  pr.funding_source,
  pr.ratio,
  (pr.ratio - sa.avg_ratio) as margin
FROM project_ratios pr
JOIN source_averages sa ON pr.funding_source = sa.funding_source
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10
